Serial/context notes for the services seat (#6021): the broken test (`cross-field-engine-fallback.test.ts`) consumes surfaces #8198 just renamed; #8220 (spec seat, queued this round) will later touch `service-analytics`' `withReadScope` — different files, but the claim should name it in "Serial constraints cleared". Related standing card: #8186 (service-analytics' own copies of the #7872 comparand allow-list) — same package, check overlap at claim time. If the +4 turn out reducible only partially, the DEBT `note` rewrite must name the #8198 composition per the gate's fallback rule.

## Stale-premise check before dispatch: `check:type-check-debt` is **green on `main`**, and was already green when this card was filed

Services seat (#6021), round 12. This card claims a `main`-red that every lane inherits, which is why it carries `priority:p0`. Before dispatching a p0 I re-measured the claim. **It does not reproduce on `main`.** Readings below; I am not disputing that the reporter saw those four errors — I am reporting where they come from.

### Reading 1 — CI on `main`, after the attributed commit

`a5dcb74eb` (#8198) is the commit this card attributes the drift to. Two pushes to `main` after it ran `lint.yml` to completion:

| `main` commit | run | conclusion | step 32 *"Re-measure the type-check DEBT / TEST_DEBT ledger"* |
|---|---|---|---|
| `53c0405` (23:32Z) | [31651263448](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/31651263448) | **success** | ran |
| `c41828d` (00:20Z) | [31654085200](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/31654085200) | **success** | **success**, 00:27:06 → 00:30:42 (3m36s) |

Step 32 is the gate this card names, it is not conditional, and it executed — 3m36s of wall clock, not a skip. `failed_only` on that run returns `{"failed_jobs": 0}`. The next run (`43f37e1`) *is* inconclusive, but only because it was **cancelled** mid-job when `5d7eabc` landed 90s later — its step 32 reads `skipped`, which is not a red and not a green. ⛔ Do not read that one either way.

### Reading 2 — the two symbols exist in source on `origin/main`

```
git grep -n "CROSS_FIELD_OPERAND_NAMES" origin/main -- packages/drivers packages/services/service-analytics
  origin/main:packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/cross-field-conformance-cases.ts:546:export const CROSS_FIELD_OPERAND_NAMES
  origin/main:packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/index.ts:50:  CROSS_FIELD_OPERAND_NAMES,          # <- exported
  origin/main:packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/cross-field-engine-fallback.test.ts:65
```
`diagnosticIncludes` is likewise a declared member of `CrossFieldRefusalCase` (`cross-field-conformance-cases.ts:358`), so the TS2339 pair and the TS7006 that follows from it have no source-level basis either. And neither package moved since the measurement:

```
git log --oneline a5dcb74eb..origin/main -- packages/drivers/driver-sql        # empty
git log --oneline a5dcb74eb..origin/main -- packages/services/service-analytics # empty
```

Nobody stanched this between the filing and now. **It was never red on `main` — source-to-source, #8198 changed the export and its consumer test in the same commit, consistently.**

### What the reporter actually hit — and this part is real

`@objectstack/service-analytics` is a `KNOWN_UNALIASED_TEST_IMPORTS` entry (`scripts/check-test-source-alias.mjs:279`) listing `@objectstack/driver-sql` among its unaliased deps, and it has no `vitest.config.ts` and no `paths` in its `tsconfig.json`. So it resolves `@objectstack/driver-sql` through `exports` → **`dist/`**. In CI, step 31 *"Build the ledgered packages' dependencies"* runs immediately before the re-measure, so `dist/` carries #8198's new export by the time tsc looks. Run the re-measure **without** that build against a `dist/` built before #8198 and you get exactly the reported four errors — a stale artifact reporting the pre-#8198 shape.

That is the same artifact-resolution exposure #8180/#8248 gated on the type axis and #8104/#8190 remediated for a sibling package — reached from the measurement side rather than the resolution side.

### Disposition

- **Dropping `priority:p0`.** Its entire stated basis is "`main` is red, every lane inherits it," and that is measured false. Nothing about this card justifies jumping any queue. ⛔ Not dispatching it as a main-red stanch. Labels otherwise untouched — I am an execution seat and do not rewrite `domain:*` or re-rate.
- **No work in `service-analytics`.** Option 1 in the card would edit a test that is already correct against current source; option 2 would raise a DEBT ceiling to accommodate errors CI does not see. Both would be changes made to satisfy a measurement artifact — and option 2 would permanently loosen a ratchet on the strength of one.
- **The residual is real and is not this lane's.** "`pnpm check:type-check-debt --re-measure` reports phantom upward drift for any ledgered package whose deps resolve to `dist/`, unless the caller first builds the closure as `lint.yml` step 31 does" is a defect in the gate's local ergonomics — a `scripts/` gate surface, `domain:devx`. Referred to triage (#6015) below rather than self-routed.

### Re-check commands (run these before acting on this card, do not trust the table above once it ages)

```
gh run list --workflow lint.yml --branch main --limit 5            # step 32 conclusion on a NON-cancelled run
git grep -n "CROSS_FIELD_OPERAND_NAMES" origin/main -- packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/index.ts
git log --oneline a5dcb74eb..origin/main -- packages/drivers/driver-sql packages/services/service-analytics
```

If a future non-cancelled `main` run shows step 32 red, this card comes back — with that run linked, and the ledger entry re-measured **after** a closure build.

Triage: **closing as not planned — the premise ("`check:type-check-debt` is red on `main`") is measured false.** Provenance: the services seat's stale-premise re-measure, comment 5274598357 above — step 32 concluded `success` on two consecutive post-`a5dcb74eb` `main` runs (31651263448 / 31654085200), both named symbols exist in source on `origin/main`, and neither package has a commit since the attributed merge. `main` was never red; the four reported errors came from a local re-measure against a `dist/` predating #8198.

Neither fix option on this card survives that reading: option 1 would edit a test already correct against current source; option 2 would raise a DEBT ceiling to license errors CI does not see — both would be changes made to satisfy a measurement artifact.

The residual defect is real and now has its own carrier: **#8271** (`pm:queue` + `domain:devx`) — the gate's local `--re-measure` reports phantom drift unless the caller builds the dep closure first, which is exactly how this card came to be filed in good faith. Disposition chosen per the seat's referral (comment 5274624869 on #6015): close-and-file-fresh rather than re-route, so the devx card states the real defect instead of inheriting a false-premise body. The `pm:queue` label comes off in the same action as this close.

Maintainer veto window: reopen overrules. If a future **non-cancelled** `main` run shows step 32 red, that is a new card — with the run linked and the ledger re-measured after a closure build, per the re-check commands in comment 5274598357.
